description: This file is a shell script for testing the diff of symlinks in a git repository. It includes functions to compute short OIDs of symlinks and files, and contains multiple test cases for different diff scenarios involving symlinks, including creation, modification, deletion, and attribute handling.

methods.name: symlink_oid
methods.description: Prints the short OID of a symlink with the given name.

methods.name: short_oid
methods.description: Prints the short OID of the given file.
